name: Mortal Kombat X — Story Mode
notes: Primary in-game Mortal Kombat X Story Mode footage accessed through a third-party gameplay upload; the uploader is preservation/access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. Chapter 1 shows Netherrealm forces attacking Earthrealm, Raiden and Fujin defending the Sky Temple/Jinsei, Shinnok confronting them, Johnny Cage manifesting green defensive power when Shinnok attacks Sonya, and Raiden imprisoning Shinnok in his own amulet.
